_readme: Captain social-media feed URLs for the instagram_harvest.py (v24.19+, when enabled).
_how_this_works: Instagram doesn't offer a free public API for non-owned accounts. Two paths to get their post feeds into Fish Finder:  (1) EASY — sign up for rss.app (free tier, 5 min), create an 'Instagram feed' for each captain, paste the resulting RSS URL below.  (2) HARDER — set up a Facebook developer account + Instagram Basic Display API and paste the access token.  When either field is populated for a captain, the nightly build will fetch and promote their posts into bait_intel.

_setup_instructions_rss_app_path: 1. Go to rss.app and sign up (free tier is fine)
2. Click 'New feed' → paste the captain's Instagram profile URL (e.g. https://www.instagram.com/newport_sportfishing/ )
3. rss.app generates a stable RSS URL that mirrors their Instagram posts
4. Copy that URL, paste it into the 'rss_url' field above for that captain, and set 'active': true
5. Send this file back to Claude (or drop it into /root/fish-finder/data/captain_socials.json), and the next nightly build will start harvesting
